```{r}
#| label: toolbox-ancova
#| include: false

tlbx_ancova_data <- met_tlbx_clean |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      .cols = dplyr::ends_with("_analytic"),
      ~ dplyr::if_else(.x < 0, NA_real_, .x)
    )
  )

tlbx_var <- c(
  "tcb_read_analytic", "tcb_vocb_analytic", "tcb_ptrncomp_analytic",
  "tcb_dccs_analytic", "tcb_flnkr_analytic", "tcb_picseq_analytic",
  "tcb_lstsrt_analytic", "tcb_crystl_analytic"
)
tlbx_label <- c(
  "Oral Reading", "Picture Vocabulary", "Pattern Comparison",
  "DCCS", "Flanker", "Picture Sequence", "List Sort", "Crystal Composite"
)
names(tlbx_label) <- tlbx_var

# fit ANCOVA models
tlbx_ancova <- lapply(
  tlbx_var,
  function(x) fit_ancova(
    dataset = tlbx_ancova_data,
    outcome = x,
    outcome_label = tlbx_label[x],
    covariates = NULL
  )
)
names(tlbx_ancova) <- tlbx_label

# extract tables from fit_ancova output
tlbx_ancova_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(
    names(tlbx_ancova),
    function(x) {
      tlbx_ancova[[x]]$tbl
    }
  )
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-toolbox-ancova
#| tbl-cap: !expr
#|    glue::glue(
#|    "Toolbox - ANCOVA results showing LS means (95% CI) for baseline and 16-week change,
#|    and between-group difference in changes. {data_caption}")

tlbx_ancova_ft <- tlbx_ancova_summary |>
  dplyr::select(-contrast_p) |>
  flextable::flextable() |>
  flextable::set_header_labels(
    Outcome = "Outcome",
    n_p = "N",
    baseline_p = "Baseline",
    baseline_p_ci = "95% CI",
    week16_p = "Week 16",
    week16_p_ci = "95% CI",
    p_change = "Change",
    p_change_ci = "95% CI",
    n_m = "N",
    baseline_m = "Baseline",
    baseline_m_ci = "95% CI",
    week16_m = "Week 16",
    week16_m_ci = "95% CI",
    m_change = "Change",
    m_change_ci = "95% CI",
    baseline_contrast_mean = "Baseline Diff",
    baseline_contrast_ci = "95% CI",
    contrast_mean = "Change Diff",
    contrast_ci = "95% CI"
  ) |>
  flextable::add_header_row(
    values = c("", "Placebo", "Metformin", "Between-Group Differences"),
    colwidths = c(1, 7, 7, 4)
  ) |>
  flextable::theme_vanilla() |>
  flextable::align(i = 1, align = "left", part = "header") |>
  flextable::align(i = 2, align = "center", part = "header") |>
  flextable::align(j = 1, align = "left", part = "all") |>
  flextable::vline(j = c(1, 8, 15), part = "all") |>
  flextable::autofit()

tlbx_ancova_ft
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-toolbox-ancova-forest
#| fig-cap: !expr
#|    glue::glue(
#|    "Toolbox - Forest plot showing between-group differences in changes. {data_caption}")

tlbx_ancova_list <- lapply(tlbx_ancova, function(x) list("fit" = x$fit$fit))

plot_ancova_forest(
  obj = tlbx_ancova_list,
  labels = tlbx_label,
  min_mult = 1.1,
  max_mult = 1.1
)
```
